スタイル: 薄暗いシーシャラウンジの空気。`assets/backgrounds/bg_eden_shop.png` 程度の2Dドット絵〜ピクセルペインター調で、輪郭・影・質感に細かいドット感を残す。リアル写真調や滑らかすぎる3D調は避ける。シーシャ台の先端は小さい凸型の金属ポストにし、凹んだカップ型・ボウル一体型・大きな先端パーツにしない。手・腕は細身で中性的、明るいピーチ系の同一肌色に統一する。
配色: 黒〜濃紫の闇に、琥珀／金（#f4d27a系）の暖色ネオンが差す。煙のかすみ。
視点: 作りパートは一人称（プレイヤーの手元を上から見下ろす角度）。
出力: PNG・透過指定のものは背景完全透過。@2x（実寸の2倍）で。指定なき限り 1280×720 基準。
NG: 文字/ロゴ/UI/数字の焼き込み（数値はゲーム側UIで出すので画像に入れない）、watermark。

Use case: production game UI asset. The reference image supplies the established black-purple and gold metal material. Create the specified static skin ONLY, a blank code-overlay-ready UI component. Refine the material into elegant black glass and finely machined warm brass, subtle smoke engraving at corners, crisp painterly microtexture. Readable quiet center; refined physical depth rather than excessive fantasy filigree. The skin itself is an interface component, but DO NOT include rendered words, letters, numbers, current values, gauge fill, zones, needles, progress or dynamic smoke. Actual controls and moving indicators are drawn by the game. Straight-on orthographic front view for this UI skin, not a tilted product shot, no hands, no surrounding scene. One single object per image. No sheet of variants. Tight crop with minimal exterior padding, clean edge alpha and no detached flecks.

A tall slender vertical temperature-instrument housing, target aspect ratio 1:5 (recommended 240 x 1200 pixels at 2x). Outer housing has four squared brass corners, slim sculpted metal side rails, an understated Art Deco cap and foot. The central aperture is one uninterrupted wide VERTICAL RECTANGLE, fully transparent from y=4% to96%, occupying the central x=25% to75%. It must be truly EMPTY so a vertical live thermometer can show through, from bottom to top without any occluding ornaments. No bulb, no liquid, no scale numerals, no fixed marks in the channel. Add extremely fine engraved tick dashes ONLY on the outer metal rails, no labels. Outer paper/object surroundings also truly transparent. The side rails catch controlled warm gold highlights, inner bevel has faint cool mint reflectivity. The frame should feel like a premium shisha workshop's precision instrument, fit a narrow slot, all edges visible.
